title: Agents now pay and shop; our store and supply plans must adapt
summary: ChatGPT Wallet lets Pro users buy via its Dots agent; Klarna joined Adyen’s agent suite; Target’s AI assistant lifted sales. Tablets fell 23% in Q3 (Omdia); PCB shortage lasts to mid-2028.

points.headline: Agent checkout is live and widening to BNPL
points.detail: ChatGPT Wallet enables agent purchases and Klarna joined Adyen’s agentic suite. We should make our catalog, checkout and financing work for agent-initiated orders.

points.headline: Device supply and demand are both under pressure
points.detail: Tablet shipments fell 23% in Q3, notebooks stay weak into 2027 and PCB shortages last to mid-2028. We should plan inventory and promotions for firmer prices.

points.headline: Fulfilment speed and small-business budgets shape channel wins
points.detail: Walmart U.S. e-commerce grew 23% on delivery speed; Amex projects a 14-year high in small-business holiday spending. Match delivery promises and push business offers.
